functions.name: logger_create_v1
functions.doc:
Create a logger from JSON config (schema v1).
Returns a non-NULL handle on success, NULL on failure.
On failure, call logger_last_error(NULL) for the message.

functions.name: logger_create
functions.doc: Alias of logger_create_v1 for early consumers.

functions.name: logger_log
functions.doc:
Emit a structured log.
fields_json may be NULL or "{}" for no extra fields.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: logger_log_simple
functions.doc: Emit a log with no extra fields.

functions.name: logger_set_fields
functions.doc: Replace runtime context fields (merged into every subsequent log).

functions.name: logger_flush
functions.doc: Drain async queue and sync sinks.

functions.name: logger_close
functions.doc: Stop worker, flush, and free the logger.

functions.name: logger_stats
functions.doc:
Stats JSON: {"queued":N,"dropped":N,"flushed":N,"bytes_written":N}
Pointer is owned by the library until the next logger_stats/logger_last_error
call on the same handle, or logger_close. Do not free it.
Returns NULL for an invalid handle; logger_last_error(NULL) then explains it.

functions.name: logger_last_error
functions.doc:
Last error for the handle. Pass NULL for global create/load errors.
Pointer is owned by the library until the next error/stats call on that
scope (handle or global), or logger_close. Do not free it.

functions.name: logger_free_string
functions.doc:
Optional free helper. Current ownership policy does not require callers
to free strings returned by logger_stats / logger_last_error.

functions.name: logger_create_from_config_file
functions.doc:
Create a logger from a config file path (YAML or JSON).
If path is empty, checks POLYGLOT_CONFIG_PATH environment variable.
If neither found, uses defaults. Returns handle on success, NULL on failure.
